description:
Apply a linear black-to-white gradient on the active layer mask channel (fade/blend).

Users often say: fade into background, gradient mask, blend subject, soft edge fade.

This paints on an existing layer mask — not a Gradient Fill layer.
Use when: softening edges or fading a layer into the background through its mask.
Do NOT use when: subject is not isolated — use photoshop_recipe_remove_background or photoshop_create_layer_mask first.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { applied, direction, angle, mask_auto_created? } }.
Preconditions: active document and active layer. Creates a reveal-all mask if none exists.
Side effects: modifies layer mask pixels; two history steps when mask is auto-created.

direction.description: Gradient fade direction on the mask (default bottom_to_top)

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool activates that document before running so a UI tab switch cannot retarget the edit.

name: photoshop_apply_gradient_mask
